title: Link destination gate reads mutable local-address configuration
description: P2 security/TOCTOU: LinkLayer._wire_is_for_local runs before _security_lock and reads mutable public identity.iid/identity.ygg_addr/local_short_addr fields. Concurrent reassignment can validate against transient target configuration and then commit replay/TOFU/receipt state under immutable _local_pubkey. Bind canonical local IID/EUI64/Ygg/short snapshots during __post_init__, use only snapshots in the gate, and add mutation regression.
